historic_survey.survey: Sunset District Residential Builders Historic Context Statement (2013)
historic_survey.note: One of five adjacent Streamline Moderne houses put up together in 1938, one of only a handful of such groupings in the Sunset District, where the style was almost always scattered singly among revival fronts. When the district was surveyed in 2012 only one of the five still showed its original design.
A Streamline Moderne house built in 1938 by the Golden Gate Investment Company, illustrated among the Sunset District tract builders' modern designs.

historical_record.description: Built by the Golden Gate Investment Company, a real estate and construction firm that put up dozens of single-family houses around 32nd Avenue and Rivera Street in the 1930s.
